fixedFindings.title: Target locators could enter state without server resolution
fixedFindings.resolution: ADD_TARGET_REFS now resolves and authorizes locators inside the locked command transaction; the pure reducer receives canonical snapshots only.

fixedFindings.title: Reasoning could propose an invented target locator
fixedFindings.resolution: Target proposals must match a target key returned by a Capiro target tool in the same turn before a pending proposal is persisted.

fixedFindings.title: Restore did not reauthorize selected targets
fixedFindings.resolution: RESTORE_STATE_VERSION reauthorizes every selected target locator before creating the restored state version.

fixedFindings.title: Duplicate emails were treated as invalid campaign state
fixedFindings.resolution: Email is no longer canonical identity. Distinct target identities remain selected and deterministic health marks the collision non-sendable.

fixedFindings.title: Selected target snapshots could become stale invisibly
fixedFindings.resolution: Profile and coverage APIs report current, changed, or unavailable source snapshots and list safe changed fields without silent mutation.

fixedFindings.title: Target capability set omitted coverage and similar-target analysis
fixedFindings.resolution: Added shared analyze_target_coverage and find_similar_targets capabilities for both Meri and Outreach.

fixedFindings.title: Target profiles silently omitted unavailable government-affairs sections
fixedFindings.resolution: Profiles now expose role, relationship, interests, objections, preferred approach, public positions, district/state nexus, bills, Program Elements, funding interests, personalization policy, and data-quality sections with explicit availability states.

fixedFindings.title: Phase 4 verifier matched forbidden strings inside its own tests
fixedFindings.resolution: Static forbidden-runtime scans now exclude specs, tests and fixtures.
